body:
## [3.111.0] - 2026-11-15

### Features

- expand function groups and color each action
- add device and company fuel switches
- add shared header function groups
- bundle DigitalPersona fingerprint support in NEXO releases

### Bug Fixes

- cancel storage timers on controller disposal
- harden Windows credential storage and recovery diagnostics
- verify admin access before refreshing offline policy
- preserve nullable cookie guards in logo requests
- rotate cookies only on requests that can adopt them
- preserve POS setup and accept Odoo cookie rotation
- improve pagination and selection handling in purchase recommendations
- keep the device switch in Fuel and cancel pending dials
- reuse access authorization and localize function names
- guard fuel transport across POS selection

### Other Changes

- isolate variant fixtures from native auth storage
- dispose provider scopes during widget teardown
- isolate receipt and transfer fixtures from auth storage
- Improve Odoo operations toolbar layout for better responsiveness and clarity
- Active sale: returning from Settings or another entry path opens the basket directly. No active sale: opens Start Shopping.
- Payment lines exist: stay on payment screen; no timeout or “Continue shopping?” popup. No payment lines: normal inactivity popup and timeout apply. Removing the last payment line restarts the timeout.
- brace stale cookie recovery guard
- initialize fuel transport fixtures explicitly
